themes.quote: U.S. Government sales continue to represent a significant portion of our revenue with substantial programs across all three segments
Commercial aerospace demand remains strong with robust order books and high production rates across the industry
We continue to focus on the PW1100G-JM engine program to ensure reliable operations and customer support
Our Raytheon segment continues to develop and deliver advanced defense systems and missiles to meet evolving global security requirements
We are actively managing supply chain constraints and working to improve our production capacity and operational efficiency
Aircraft financing commitments, in the form of debt or lease financing, are provided to certain commercial aerospace customers
Pratt & Whitney holds a 61% program share interest in the International Aero Engines AG (IAE) collaboration with MTU Aero Engines AG (MTU) and Japanese Aero Engines Corporation (JAEC)

Due to the nature of the work required to be performed on many of the Company's performance obligations, the estimation of total revenue and cost at completion is complex, subject to many inputs, and requires significant judgment

We have entered into industrial cooperation agreements, sometimes in the form of either offset agreements or ICIP agreements, as a condition to obtaining orders for our products and services from certain customers in foreign countries
We continue to ramp production of the GTF engine to meet near-term demand
increased demand for advanced defense systems and modernization programs
strong aftermarket services revenue and long-term maintenance contracts
initiatives to optimize supply chain and improve manufacturing efficiency
completed strategic divestitures to focus on core defense and aerospace businesses
